name: Hovatter's Wildlife Zoo
distance: About 26 miles from Oakland — roughly 45 minutes, and over the state line
blurb: A family-run zoo in rural Preston County with over thirty species, chimpanzees and grizzlies and giraffes among them. Reported to have a walk-in room full of parakeets, which is the bit people remember.
season: Opens 11 April 2026 for its 34th season. Closing date and daily hours are not confirmed.

admission.note: Charged. The zoo does not publish prices on its front page and we have not confirmed them — ring ahead.

warnings: This is in West Virginia, not Garrett County. Everything else on this site is Maryland.
A private business sets its own hours and prices and can change them without notice. Ring before driving 45 minutes.

sources.label: West Virginia Zoo: official site
sources.note: The operator. Gives the 11 April 2026 opening, the 34th season, the phone number, and the species list. Publishes no admission prices or daily hours on the front page.

sources.label: West Virginia Zoo: directions
sources.note: Confirms Hovatter's Wildlife Zoo and West Virginia Zoo are the same place, gives the address, and routes visitors from Oakland, Maryland — though it describes the zoo as east of Oakland when it is west.

reports.what: A bit far out, but genuinely fun — and there's a room full of parakeets.

outstanding: PRIORITY: get admission prices and daily hours from the zoo directly. Neither is published on the site and both are what someone needs before driving 45 minutes.
Confirm the parakeet room — the zoo's own site never mentions it, and it is the thing our reporter singled out.
Confirm the closing date of the season.
Confirm whether it is walk-through, drive-through or both, and roughly how long a visit takes.
Confirm whether the directions page really means west of Oakland rather than east.
